anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, bulbous convexity with a large pixel radius, showing a smooth, continuous arc from the dorsal ridge to the snout.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Blunt and extremely short; the beak does not extend significantly from the melon inflection, resulting in a low length-to-thickness ratio.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Highly obtuse and indistinct; the slope transition from the melon to the rostrum is nearly seamless with no sharp crease.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear striations and irregular depigmented patches are visible across the mid-lateral and dorsal-lateral integument.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin is visible with a wide base and tapered tip; the eye is visible as a small, dark pixel cluster located posteriorly to the mouthline.
